name: Add Agent Tools
description: Load operation definitions into this conversation with an append-only tool event. An operation already declared by agent config, an active load or an advertised skill may be selected directly; any other operation requires an explicit tool/load capability. Loading does not grant invoke authority. The result returns a persistent load key; pass it to context_unload only when you need to remove the tools.

operations.description: Exact operation paths already present in the agent surface or covered by tool/load capability
